> 第八章 狠辣（第1页）
乔克的速度再快，也快不过塞恩的瞬发魔法。
不愧是正式黑魔法师摩西多大师的作品，强酸手杖距离上一次被使用，也不过二十个小时的时间，如今竟然已经完全恢复，甚至都无需塞恩自己为手杖进行充能。
这就是高级魔法道具的最显著特征之一。
在摩西多大师的炼金设计下，强酸手杖凭借其内部魔法铭文与元素晶核，自己就能完成能量循环与补充。
虽然每次只能使用一次，但该手杖的冷却间隔只有短短二十个小时，
难怪高级魔法学徒莉莉安雅也会对塞恩的强酸手杖起窥觑之心，这种级别的魔法道具，对于高级学徒也是不可多得的精品装备。
能够轻易融化高级魔兽鳞甲的腐蚀酸液，用来对付乔克自然不在话下。
仅仅是电光石火之间，其它黑魔法学徒甚至都没看清楚具体发生了什么，紧接着就传来乔克的一声惨叫。
乔克的体质的确强壮，但他绝对无法和高级魔兽相提并论。
塞恩的强酸手杖瞄准的是乔克的胸膛，只要一击命中，哪怕他是中级学徒，躯体组织也得化为一滩黄水。
但乔克终究是一名中级学徒，其反应能力要超过已经被塞恩干掉的伊尔克许多。
比低级学徒更强的精神力，使得他能够在万分危急时刻拼尽全力扭动自己的肌肉组织，包括其强壮的体格也在这个时候救了他一命。
当强酸手杖所发射腐蚀酸液余势未减的命中黑街某商店门栏，“嘶嘶”的白色腐蚀烟气产生，参与这场莫名混战的众人，才看清楚乔克的具体处境。
“嘶！”只见一名低级黑魔法学徒不禁倒吸一口凉气。
在他的视线中，疤脸乔克竟是整支右臂被腐蚀成了一滩烂泥。
原本被乔克握于手中，并且散发着淡淡火元素波纹的短剑，早已随乔克的骨骼、肌肤一起腐烂为铁水。
那柄短剑只是一柄质地不错的普通武器而已，连魔法装备都不是，又如何能挡得住塞恩的强酸手杖。
魔法学徒间的战斗，由于彼此手段单一，防护力普遍低下，因此基本都是转瞬间便能决出胜负。

更何况这场战斗进行的如此突然，别说疤脸乔克一伙人猝不及防，就连附近黑街的路人，甚至是那些商店的店家们也没反应过来。
近二十枚次级火球术的爆炸，让这片黑街附近升起滚滚浓烟。
其中夹杂的惨叫和呻吟声更是不少。
除了疤脸乔克之外，其它最为倒霉的，莫过于他们同行的
一伙人中，那群实力低微的低级学徒和入门级学徒了。
但这并不是结束，随着莉娜口中的魔法咒语终于吟唱结束，一束直径足有近两米的黑色光柱，猛然在其手链前汇聚完成，并朝着面前众人射去。
作为高级学徒，莉娜所掌握的魔法攻击手段与威力，与寻常中、低级学徒俨然已是云泥。
并且与塞恩释放的腐蚀酸液不同的是，莉娜前后释放的两道大威力高级魔法，竟然都是范围型攻击魔法！
这个疯女人果然没有因为地处黑街就有任何收敛。
又是两道凄厉的惨叫声响起，这两道惨叫分别来自于场内的两名中级男性学徒。
唯有那个掌握音波系魔法的女学徒，由于在释放女妖尖叫后及时撤开了战场中央，因此她竟是在场围攻塞恩两人中，唯一一个站到最后的中级学徒。
塞恩和莉娜创造的战果辉煌，但同样他俩也不是毫发无伤。
除了吃了一记那名中级女学徒的女妖尖叫之外，被莉娜以黑光击倒的那两个男性学徒在倒下前也各自释放了一道魔法。
“石矛冲击”“火焰刀”两道中级魔法在塞恩和莉娜周围爆炸。
塞恩运气很好，总数三根的石矛，只有一根擦中了他的手臂，而火焰刀却是让他的左半边躯体产生中度烧伤，学院发下的黑色魔法袍，竟是被烧燎了三分之一。
莉娜的情况不比塞恩好多少，这是一场两败俱伤的战斗。
也得亏那些低级学徒释放魔法的速度普遍较慢，并且对于在黑街出手一事，很多学徒还心有忧虑。

The latest chapter of Lord of Ash_Chapter 8 Cruel Page 1_Lord of Ash I love Xiaodou_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 8 Cruel (Page 1)
No matter how fast Jock is, he can't be faster than Thane's instant magic.
Worthy of being the work of the official black magician Master Mosido, the acid cane has only been used for twenty hours, and it has now completely recovered. Thain does not even need to recharge the cane himself.
This is one of the most striking features of advanced magic props.
Under the alchemical design of Master Mosido, the strong acid cane can complete energy circulation and replenishment by itself with its internal magic inscriptions and elemental crystal nuclei.
Although it can only be used once at a time, the cane's cooldown interval is only twenty hours.
No wonder senior magic apprentice Lilianya also looks at Thain's acid cane. Magic props of this level are also rare high-quality equipment for senior apprentices.
The corrosive acid that can easily melt the scales of high-level monsters can be used to deal with Jock.
In just a flash of lightning, the other black magic apprentices didn't even see clearly what happened, and then came a scream from Jock.
Jock's physique is indeed strong, but he is definitely not comparable to high-level monsters.
Thain's acid cane was aimed at Jock's chest. As long as one hit hit, even if he was an intermediate apprentice, his body tissue would turn into a puddle of yellow water.
But Jock is an intermediate apprentice after all, and his reaction ability is much better than that of Ilk, who has been killed by Thane.
With a stronger mental power than a low-level apprentice, he was able to twist his muscle tissue with all his strength in extremely critical moments, including his strong physique, which also saved his life at this time.
When the corrosive acid emitted by the strong acid cane hit the door of a store on a dark street with unabated force, "hissing" white corrosive smoke was produced, and everyone involved in the inexplicable melee could clearly see Jock's specific situation.
"Hiss!" A low-level black magic apprentice gasped.
In his sight, Scarface Jock's entire right arm was corroded into a puddle of mud.
The dagger that was originally held in Jock's hand and exuded a faint fire element ripple had long since rotted into molten iron along with Jock's bones and skin.
That dagger was just an ordinary weapon of good quality, not even a magic weapon, so how could it block Thane's acid cane.
In battles between magic apprentices, due to each other's single method and generally low protection, the outcome can basically be decided in an instant.
What's more, the battle happened so suddenly. Not to mention Scarface Jock and his group were caught off guard, even the passers-by on the nearby black streets and even the store owners in those shops didn't react.
The explosion of nearly twenty secondary fireball spells caused billowing smoke to rise near this dark street.
There were a lot of screams and moans mixed in among them.
Apart from Scarface Jock, the others who are most unlucky are their fellow travelers.
Among the group of people were the low-level apprentices and entry-level apprentices with low strength.
But this was not the end. As the magic spell in Lina's mouth finally ended, a black beam of light nearly two meters in diameter suddenly gathered in front of her bracelet and shot toward everyone in front of her.
As a high-level apprentice, Lina's magical attack methods and power are completely different from those of ordinary mid-level and low-level apprentices.
And unlike the corrosive acid released by Thane, the two powerful high-level magics released by Lina were both ranged attack magics!
As expected, this crazy woman didn't restrain herself at all just because she was on a dark street.
Two more shrill screams rang out. These two screams came from two intermediate male apprentices in the field.
Only the female apprentice who mastered sonic magic withdrew from the center of the battlefield in time after releasing the banshee scream.As a result, she was actually the only intermediate apprentice who stood to the end among the two people who besieged Thain.
The results achieved by Thane and Lena were brilliant, but they were not unscathed either.
In addition to eating the banshee scream of the mid-level female apprentice, the two male apprentices who were knocked down by Lina with black light also each released a magic before they fell.
Two intermediate magics, "Stone Spear Impact" and "Flaming Knife", exploded around Thain and Lina.
Thain was very lucky. Only one of the three stone spears in total hit his arm, while the flame knife caused moderate burns on the left half of his body. A third of the black magic robe issued by the academy was burned.
Lena's situation is no better than Thane's, and it's a lose-lose battle.
This is also due to the fact that low-level apprentices are generally slow to release magic, and many apprentices are still worried about taking action on the underworld.
